note: Set B binds the wiring-schedule rows to the correct symbol numbers (20, 31, 32, 33, 34, 50, 150, 151, 10) and correctly reads the notes and title-block facts (200A/2P NFDS, NEMA 3R junction box and sub-panel enclosure, lot number 113, revisions 03/04). Set A invents three wire specifications (101, 105, 106 – 'CU #10, STR', 'MIN R=3.0"') that appear nowhere in the text layer, misbinds the 200A/2P rating to the SUB-PANEL main breaker (which the notes give as 50A/2P), and repeatedly misquotes 'NEMA 3R' as 'NEMA 3' and 'NFDS' as 'NPDFS'. A does capture a few facts B omits (60A DC NFDS, 120/240V, 2P main breaker), but its errors are substantive misreadings and fabrications, while B's flaws are mainly vague entities, a garbled 'ground fault' claim bound to the main breaker instead of the inverter, and an unsupported '4 connected to 31' link.
